ddl.value:
"status" IN ('queued','running','sent','suppressed','failed','uncertain')
    AND ("status" = 'running') = ("lease_token" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("lease_token" IS NULL) = ("lease_until" IS NULL)
    AND ("status" = 'sent') = ("sent_at" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("status" <> 'queued' OR "dispatch_started_at" IS NULL)
    AND "attempt_count" BETWEEN 0 AND 5
    AND "created_at" <= "event_at"
    AND "event_at" <= "available_at" AND "available_at" < "expires_at"
    AND ("sent_at" IS NULL OR "sent_at" >= "dispatch_started_at")
    AND ("dispatch_started_at" IS NULL OR "dispatch_started_at" >= "event_at")
    AND ("status" <> 'sent' OR "dispatch_started_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: action_item_email_lifecycle_check

ddl.value:
"kind" = 'PL' AND "status" IN ('in_progress','closed','unknown')
    AND "number" > 0 AND "year" BETWEEN 1800 AND 9999
    AND "official_url" LIKE 'https://%'
    AND (CASE WHEN "house_key" IN ('CD','SF') THEN "uf" IS NULL
      WHEN "house_key" = 'CLDF' THEN "uf" IS NOT NULL AND "uf" = 'DF'
      ELSE "uf" IN ('AC','AL','AP','AM','BA','CE','ES','GO','MA','MT','MS','MG','PA','PB','PR','PE','PI','RJ','RN','RS','RO','RR','SC','SP','SE','TO')
        AND "uf" IS NOT NULL AND "house_key" = 'AL-' || "uf" END)
ddl.name: legislative_bills_state_check

ddl.value:
"state" IN ('queued','running','ready','failed') AND "attempts" >= 0
    AND ("state" = 'running') = ("lease_token" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("lease_token" IS NULL) = ("lease_until" IS NULL)
    AND ("state" = 'ready') = ("payload" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("payload" IS NULL) = ("generated_at" IS NULL)
ddl.name: compendium_summary_state_check

ddl.value:
"state" IN ('pending','accepted','declined','withdrawn')
    AND ("state" = 'pending') = ("responded_at" IS NULL)
    AND ("state" = 'withdrawn') = ("withdrawn_at" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("responded_at" IS NULL OR "responded_at" >= "proposed_at")
    AND ("withdrawn_at" IS NULL OR "withdrawn_at" >= "responded_at")
ddl.name: action_assignments_state_check

ddl.value:
("agenda_item_id" IS NULL) <> ("poll_id" IS NULL)
    AND "description" ~ '[^[:space:]]' AND "version" >= "due_revision" AND "due_revision" > 0
    AND "status" IN ('open','completed','cancelled')
    AND ("closed_by_user_id" IS NULL) = ("closed_at" IS NULL)
    AND ("status" = 'open') = ("closed_at" IS NULL)
    AND "updated_at" >= "created_at"
    AND ("closed_at" IS NULL OR "closed_at" BETWEEN "created_at" AND "updated_at")
ddl.name: action_items_state_check

ddl.value:
("review_status" = 'pending' AND "reviewed_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "reviewed_at" IS NULL)
    OR ("review_status" IN ('approved', 'rejected') AND "reviewed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL
      AND "reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "reviewed_at" >= "created_at")
ddl.name: meeting_agenda_items_review_check

ddl.value: "provisioning" IN ('manual','automatic') AND ("provisioning" = 'automatic' OR "google_meet_url" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: meeting_provisioning_check

ddl.value:
"resulting_version" > 1
    AND "action" IN ('edit','publish','reject','hide','delete')
    AND "from_visibility" IN ('unpublished','published','hidden')
    AND "to_visibility" IN ('unpublished','published','hidden','deleted')
    AND ("revision_id" IS NULL) = ("action" = 'delete')
ddl.name: minute_events_state_check

ddl.value:
char_length("body") BETWEEN 1 AND 32000 AND "title" ~ '[^[:space:]]'
    AND "source_kind" IN ('meet_transcript','notes','none')
ddl.name: minute_revision_content_check

ddl.value:
"version" > 0 AND "attempt_count" >= 0
    AND "source_kind" IN ('meet_transcript','notes','none')
    AND "generation_status" IN ('queued','running','ready','unavailable','failed')
    AND "visibility" IN ('unpublished','published','hidden','deleted')
    AND ("draft_status" IS NULL OR "draft_status" IN ('pending','rejected'))
    AND ("draft_revision_id" IS NULL) = ("draft_status" IS NULL)
    AND ("published_revision_id" IS NULL) = ("published_at" IS NULL)
    AND ("visibility" NOT IN ('published','hidden') OR "published_revision_id" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("visibility" = 'deleted') = ("deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)
    AND ("lease_token" IS NULL) = ("lease_until" IS NULL)
    AND ("visibility" = 'deleted' OR ("generation_status" = 'running') = ("lease_token" IS NOT NULL))
    AND ("generation_status" <> 'queued' OR "next_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL)
ddl.name: minutes_state_check

ddl.value:
("status" = 'pending') = ("resolved_at" IS NULL)
    AND ("resolved_at" IS NULL OR "resolved_at" >= "requested_at")
ddl.name: meeting_organizer_transfers_resolution_check

ddl.value:
("resolved_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("origin" = 'invitation' AND "status" <> 'pending')
    AND ("resolved_at" IS NULL OR "resolved_at" >= "created_at")
ddl.name: meeting_participants_resolution_check

ddl.value:
("closed_at" IS NULL) = ("closed_by_user_id" IS NULL)
    AND ("closed_at" IS NULL OR "closed_at" >= "opened_at")
ddl.name: meeting_polls_close_state_check

ddl.value: "version" > 0 AND "docx_bytes" > 0 AND jsonb_typeof("entries") = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("entries") > 0 AND cardinality("provider_transcript_names") > 0
ddl.name: transcript_snapshot_content_check

ddl.value: "schedule_version" > 0 AND ("scheduled_ends_at" IS NULL OR "scheduled_ends_at" > "starts_at") AND ("cancelled_at" IS NULL OR "ended_at" IS NULL)
ddl.name: meetings_schedule_check

ddl.value:
("ended_at" IS NULL) = ("ended_by_user_id" IS NULL)
    AND ("ended_at" IS NULL OR "ended_at" >= "starts_at")
ddl.name: meetings_end_state_check
